final: WITH station_phase AS (SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage), phase AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bandusage) AS avg_bandusage, SUM(record_count) AS record_count FROM station_phase GROUP BY lunarstage), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS record_count FROM phase) SELECT p.lunarstage, p.avg_bandusage, p.record_count, CAST(p.record_count AS REAL) / total.record_count AS share FROM phase AS p CROSS JOIN total WHERE total.record_count IS NOT NULL
